items.html:
Implemented the minimal cap in threads.rs: retain the existing serial cutoff, then limit workers to m*n*k / 65536. Added an exact-bit regression across seven matrix shapes and budgets 1/4/16/32.

Final comparisons against 0.1.0:

Workload Before → after Gain
64-mode stack, 32 threads 17.38 → 1.14 ms ~15×
Dense four-particle cluster, 32 threads 6.85 → 0.70 ms ~10×
Dense 16-particle cluster, 32 threads 36.09 → 14.08 ms ~2.6×
N512/P8 iterative forward, four threads 1.252 → 0.103 s ~12.2×
Complete corresponding gradient 2.563 → 0.235 s ~10.9×

All final timing gates passed. Six complete workflows preserve identical bits across all four budgets.

Retained limitation: four-thread N16 loses an intermediate stage6 improvement, but matches the published baseline within the unchanged regression limit. The extra ≤4-worker exception did not help, so it was removed.

Evidence: benchmarks/results/local/cpu-scheduling-20261004/summary.json. Root now owns full CI and publication work. No commits or pushes made here.
